description: Purpose-aware, non-destructive Assets Library and adaptive contextual quick-controls for 78 scene elements. Existing Design Inspector stays intact.

floatingToolbar.eligibleQuickCandidates: Read elementSchemas[elementId].toolbar.quickControlCandidates and composed slots when present
floatingToolbar.adaptiveRanking: Show up to five quick controls from candidates after evaluating visibility and context. Put extras in compact More controls popover; separate "Advanced" opens unchanged Design Inspector.
floatingToolbar.textEditing: Hide compact quick toolbar while direct text typing is active; restore on editing exit
floatingToolbar.creationBehavior: Show upon creation once selected; no AI/image generation at creation time
floatingToolbar.popoverOpenBehavior: One at a time; close on Escape, selection change and click outside; preserve current state
floatingToolbar.smallScreen: Use bottom-sheet popover and condensed toolbar; do not overlay critical canvas controls

uiPolicy.progressiveDisclosure: Show base choice, then only context-relevant variations; keep non-applicable values in state only if harmless, exclude from export if invalid.
uiPolicy.unset: null or omitted; no guessing missing values
uiPolicy.inputBehavior: Field changes update canvas metadata, guides and prompt spec; do not regenerate photo pixels unless explicit image generation/edit action occurs.
uiPolicy.assetBehavior: Empty slots for images and logos when no assets exist; do not fabricate real photographs, logos, awards, claims, or quotes.
uiPolicy.styleBehavior: Typography, colors and brand kit tokens are inherited by default and can be overridden per element.
uiPolicy.undoRedo: Each committed change is a reversible editor transaction.
uiPolicy.applicability: A visual element may be a layer, a reference to a layer, or a scene/layout constraint; the UI must distinguish their types.
uiPolicy.validation: Validate option values, conditional rules, linked targets, relationships, data types, and required fields before generating a final spec.

globalControls.note: Contextual group controls are additional to common transform actions.

fieldVisibility.cascadeVisibility: A field is visible only if its parent facet and all ancestor conditions are visible. Hidden/inapplicable values never export.
fieldVisibility.evaluation: Evaluate visibleWhen against current explicit/effective element property state. Defer fields until their parent selection exists.

runtimeRules.fieldReferences: Properties have stable dotted keys; value paths are not canvas-layer IDs.
runtimeRules.assetReferences: Stored asset ID + metadata, never embedded base64 in schema; preserve exact images unless user explicitly edits.
runtimeRules.canvasReferences: Links store target layer IDs with allowed type checks, stable through grouping/rename; clear or remap if target is deleted.
runtimeRules.scope: scene props inherit scene configuration. Per-element camera/light overrides must be labeled explicit overrides.
runtimeRules.export: Generate only explicitly selected or valid preset values; include element relationship edges and independent scene defaults. Skip hidden invalid fields.
runtimeRules.generateVsPreview: Toolbar can render editable metadata overlay; true photorealistic changes need actual image generation/editing.
runtimeRules.humanPose: Base action > variation > body orientation > torso twist > head direction > limbs > motion phase > relation to object.
runtimeRules.childSafety: For child/teen model presets, filter age-inappropriate wardrobe, styling or posing options and prevent adult-specific body styling.
runtimeRules.evidence: Sources for testimonials, awards, prices, metrics and comparisons must be user supplied or verifiable; do not invent them.
runtimeRules.compositeAndText: For nested layout/text models, changes propagate to linked children without silently overwriting child overrides.
runtimeRules.purposeMapping: Changing Creative Purpose recomputes library recommendations only and does not modify existing canvas, visual format, inspector config, or saved element properties.
runtimeRules.quickCandidates: Field keys must exist in owning element facetRefs or elementFields, and hidden/inapplicable controls may not display or export. Candidate metadata never replaces underlying canonical field definitions.
runtimeRules.preserveDesignInspector: No deletion, remapping, renaming, visual redesign or moving of current Design Inspector sections/fields.
runtimeRules.interactionOnInsert: Add element, select, show floating toolbar with quick controls, and bind existing inspector to selected instance as an undoable transaction.

exampleConditionalUI: Select person → choose Standing → choose Turning around → show Turn phase, Direction, Body/Head controls.
Select CTA → choose URL target → show destination field; leave blank if unknown.
Select Product → Held by model → show Select model relationship target.
Select Chart → reveal type, series, axes and source; only display numeric values if supplied.

purposeSelector.label: Creative Purpose
purposeSelector.noneSelectedMode: Show popular/general elements in the same seven groups; full catalog accessible
purposeSelector.selectionBehavior: Update recommendations only. Never delete/reposition/add canvas layers or mutate Design Inspector state.

informationArchitecture.searchBehavior: Search by label, synonym, group, tags; search always covers full catalog
informationArchitecture.mandatoryBadgeUse: Required is a suggestion in the library, not insertion into canvas
informationArchitecture.emptyState: Show general-purpose elements and All Elements, not a blank library

recommendedComputation.dedupe: by canonical elementId; required takes precedence
recommendedComputation.sort: required, then suggested, then general controls; keep 7 groups in declared order
recommendedComputation.visualType: If user has chosen Visual Type, union its requiredElements with purpose requirements; do not introduce Visual Type selector to this sidebar if already defined elsewhere
recommendedComputation.addedState: Derive Added count and per-canvas instance list from scene layers, not stored badges
recommendedComputation.missingRequired: Non-blocking missing markers; do not prevent purpose change, export, or manual creative choices.

elementCreation.factory: Use existing layer creation and canonical elementId; subtype aliases map to existing types

modelMapping.displayPlaceholder: Empty human subject placeholder, not a generated stock photo

elementCreation.assetPlaceholder: Empty image/logo/model slots until provided; never generate realistic assets automatically.

designInspectorConstraint.scopeOfChanges: Assets Library surface, selected-canvas floating toolbar, additive schema fields and shared selection state only
designInspectorConstraint.syncOnly: Selection and underlying property mutations via existing state architecture; do not fork edit state

assetCardTemplate.default: Compact and professional; no massive nested cards
